question: Why did the LORD say He would give the vast Aramean army into Israel's hands?
options: Because Ahab had built a new altar
Because the Arameans had no king
Because the Arameans thought the LORD was a god of the hills and not of the valleys
explanation: A man of God said that because the Arameans thought the LORD was a god of the hills and not of the valleys, He would deliver their army, and Israel would know that He is the LORD.
